products.name: Scholé Learn by Building
products.tagline_zh: Learning should be more than "click next"
products.description_zh: Learn by building, on any website, with Scholé by your side. You can read about a tool, watch someone walk through it on YouTube, or ask ChatGPT to explain it. But you won’t properly learn until you build with it yourself. Learn Anywhere mode guides you through using any real tool directly on your screen, adapting tasks and giving visual hints. Everything you learn updates your Scholé knowledge graph and counts towards your lessons. Our thesis? Learn it well enough to use it.

products.tagline_zh: The fastest, most accurate memory layer for AI agents
products.description_zh: Maximem Synap is memory and context infrastructure for AI agents, so every conversation does not start from zero. Native across 22 frameworks including LangChain, LangGraph, and the Claude Agent SDK. Free tier, no credit card required.
